(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define working g)
  (define all-os (objects working 0))
  (define (score obj) (obj-size obj))
  (define (choose color)
    (define candidates (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) all-os))
    (first (sort candidates (lambda (a b) (> (score a) (score b))))))
  (define selected (list (choose 2) (choose 3)))
  (foldl (lambda (obj out)
    (if (member (obj-color obj) '(2 3))
      (recolor-cells out (obj-cells obj) (if (= (obj-color obj) 2) 4 1))
      out))
    (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) selected)))

programs.4c586ccd066c25748fdd251e477deb447093f497:
(rule! (lambda (grid)
  (define all-objects (objects grid 0))
  (define (largest-of color)
    (first
      (sort
        (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) all-objects)
        (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
  (let* ((largest-red (largest-of 2))
         (largest-green (largest-of 3))
         (blank (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0)))
    (recolor-cells
      (recolor-cells blank (obj-cells largest-red) 4)
      (obj-cells largest-green) 1))))

  (define all-os (objects working 0))
  (define (score obj) (- (first (obj-bbox obj))))
  (define (choose color)
    (define candidates (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) all-os))
    (first (sort candidates (lambda (a b) (> (score a) (score b))))))
  (define selected (list (choose 2) (choose 3)))
  (foldl (lambda (obj out)
    (if (member (obj-color obj) '(2 3))
      (recolor-cells out (obj-cells obj) (if (= (obj-color obj) 2) 4 1))
      out))
    (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) selected)))

(rule! (lambda (grid)
  (define merged (map-grid grid
    (lambda (r c v) (if (= v 8) 2 v))))
  ((lambda (grid)
  (define all-objects (objects grid 0))
  (define (largest-of color)
    (first
      (sort
        (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) all-objects)
        (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
  (let* ((largest-red (largest-of 2))
         (largest-green (largest-of 3))
         (blank (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0)))
    (recolor-cells
      (recolor-cells blank (obj-cells largest-red) 4)
      (obj-cells largest-green) 1))) merged)))

python.scope: Independent Python mirror only; protected subset reported separately.

rivals.bbox_area: Largest bounding-box area per source color, stable scan-order ties.
rivals.bbox_perimeter: Largest bounding-box perimeter per source color (height + width score).
rivals.bottommost: Component with largest maximum row per source color.
rivals.cell_perimeter: Largest count of exposed orthogonal cell edges per source color.
rivals.connected_8_only: In merge mode, exclude transformed components containing no original red.
rivals.erase_bridge_pixels: Merge and rank correctly, then erase originally color-8 pixels from the output.
rivals.exclude_8_from_size: Merge connectivity, but rank red components by original red cell count only.
rivals.first_component: First component of each source color in row-major discovery order.
rivals.global_all_top_two: Two globally largest nonzero components; only selected red/green cells paint.
rivals.global_target_top_two: Two globally largest red/green components, regardless of color balance.
rivals.ignore_8: Always rank original red/green components; ignore all color 8.
rivals.keep_all_targets: Recolor every red/green cell after the setting's preprocessing.
rivals.last_component: Last component of each source color in row-major discovery order.
rivals.leftmost: Component with smallest minimum column per source color.
rivals.longest_span: Largest bounding-box width or height per source color.
rivals.rightmost: Component with largest maximum column per source color.
rivals.select_before_merge: In merge mode, select the original red winner, then retain its merged component.
rivals.shortest_span: Largest shorter bounding-box side per source color.
rivals.solid_bbox: Choose by correct cell count, but fill each winner's bounding box.
rivals.topmost: Component with smallest minimum row per source color.
